chapterInfo.content:
2
Asɔrefie a ɛtɔ so mmienu no animuonyam
1Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako no, AWURADE asɛm nam Odiyifoɔ Hagai so baa sɛ: 2Ka kyerɛ Sealtiel ba Serubabel, Yuda amrado no, ne Yehosadak ba Yosua, ɔsɔfo panin no, ne ɔman no nkaeɛ no sɛ: 3#Esra 3.12 Mo mu hwan na aka a ɔhunuu ɛdan yi n’akane animuonyam no? Na afei mohu no sɛn? Ɛnte sɛ adeɛ a ɛnyɛ hwee, mo ani so? 4Na afei, hyɛ wo ho den Serubabel, AWURADE asɛm nie, na hyɛ wo ho den, Yehosadak, ba Yosua, ɔsɔfo panin, na monhyɛ mo ho den, asase no so man nyinaa, AWURADE asɛm nie, na monyɛ adwuma no. Na medi mo akyi, asafo AWURADE asɛm nie. 5#Eks 19.5; Sak 4.6 Ɛsiane apam a me ne mo pameeɛ berɛ a mofirii Misraim baeɛ no, ɛna me honhom a ɛte mo mu no nti, monnsuro. 6#Heb 12.26 Na sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Bio! Aka kumaa sɛ mawoso ɔsoro ne asase ne ɛpo ne asase pɛsɛɛ, 7na mɛwoso amanaman nyinaa, na amanaman nyinaa de w’agyapadeɛ bɛba, na mede animuonyam bɛhyɛ efie yi ma, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 8Me na sika ne dwetɛ wɔ me, asafo AWURADE asɛm nie. 9So na ɛdan yi animuonyam bɛso, akyire yi deɛ no bɛsene kane deɛ no, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na ɛha na mɛma asomdwoeɛ, asafo AWURADE asɛm nie.
Nhyira a ɛbata asɔrefie no ho
10Bosome a ɛtɔ so nkron no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan, Dario afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu, AWURADE asɛm nam Odiyifoɔ Hagai so baa sɛ: 11Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: Bisa asɔfoɔ no na wɔmmua asɛmmisa yi sɛ: 12Hwɛ, sɛ obi kura nam kronkron n’atadeɛ mmuano mu, na ɔde mmuano no kɔka paanoo ne aduane a wɔanoa ne nsa ne ngo ne aduane biara a, ɛbɛyɛ kronkron anaa? Na asɔfoɔ no bua see sɛ: Dabi. 13#Lew 5.2; Num 19.22 Na Hagai bisaa sɛ: Sɛ, efunu nti, deɛ ne ho akum kɔka yeinom biara a, na ɛho akum anaa? Na asɔfoɔ no bua see sɛ: Aane, ɛho akum. 14Ɛnna Hagai bua see sɛ: Saa na nkurɔfoɔ yi teɛ, na saa na ɔman yi teɛ wɔ m’anim, AWURADE asɛm nie, na saa na wɔn nsa ano adwuma nyinaa ne deɛ wɔde brɛ me hɔ no teɛ: Ɛho akum. 15Na afei monhwɛ deɛ ɛfiri nnɛ rekorɔ yi ɛbɛba. Wɔnnya mfaa ɔboɔ ntoo ɔboɔ soɔ AWURADE asɔrefie mu, 16#Hag 1.6 ɛyɛɛ mo deɛn? Obi ba ayukuo susuo adeɛ aduonu ho a, na ɛyɛ du. Obi ba nsa-kyi-amena ho bɛsa nhina aduonum a, na ɛyɛ aduonu. 17#Hag 1.11 Mede ɔhoɔ ne ɔpoɔ ne asukɔtweaa bɔɔ mo, mo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa, nanso moannane amma me nkyɛn, AWURADE asɛm nie. 18Afei monhwɛ mfiri ɛnnɛ da yi de rekorɔ, momfiri bosome a ɛtɔ so nkron no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan a ɛne da a wɔhyɛɛ AWURADE asɔrefie no aseɛ no nhwɛ. 19Na aba bi da so wɔ ɛsan so? Bobe ne borɔdɔma ne atoaa aba ne ngodua ɛso anaa? Ɛda yi na mɛfiri aseɛ mahyira mo.
Wɔma Serubabel so
20Na AWURADE asɛm baa Hagai nkyɛn ne mprenu so, bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan mu sɛ: 21#Hag 2.6 Ka kyerɛ Yuda amrado, Serubabel sɛ: Merebɛwoso ɔsoro ne asase, 22na mɛbutu ahennie nhennwa, na masɛe amanaman ahennie ahoɔden, na mɛbutu nteaseɛnam ne wɔn a ɛtete mu, na apɔnkɔ ne wɔn a wɔtete wɔn soɔ sotenafoɔ ahwehwe ase, na obi atɔ ne nua afena ano. 23#Sak 4.6-7 Ɛda no, asafo AWURADE asɛm nie, mɛfa wo, Sealtiel ba Serubabel, m’akoa, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na mede wo ayɛ sɛ nsɔanodeɛ; na wo na mafa wo ayɛ me deɛ, asafo AWURADE asɛm nie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
